items.title: Why Is VREX Stock Surging Today?
items.summary: Teledyne Technologies is set to acquire all outstanding common shares of Varex Imaging for $18.90 per share payable in cash, representing a significant premium of over 50% over Friday’s closing price.

items.title: Teledyne Technologies to Buy Varex Imaging for $1.1 Billion
items.summary: Teledyne Technologies said it will buy Varex Imaging for about $1.1 billion, inclusive of equity awards and debt.

items.title: Does Teledyne (TDY) Reveal a New Capital Playbook With ESOP Shelf, Buyback and Safety Launch?
items.summary: In July 2026, Teledyne Technologies completed a US$399.98 million share repurchase of 788,104 shares and filed a US$651.22 million shelf registration to offer 1,000,000 common shares for an ESOP-related program, while its Gas and Flame Detection unit launched the MCX32-TP industrial safety controller. items.title: Teledyne Technologies (TDY) Launches MCX32 TP For Industrial Safety Systems
items.summary: Teledyne Technologies (NYSE:TDY) has introduced the MCX32-TP gas and flame detection controller in its Gas and Flame Detection segment. The MCX32-TP is positioned as a next generation controller for advanced industrial safety systems. The platform focuses on modular design and connectivity for use across industries such as oil and gas, water treatment, and petrochemicals.
